Video of the ECU being bench-tested or communicating with a diagnostic scanner.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Bosch engine control unit, but its working condition, exact fitment, and lock status are unproven, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working, unconfirmed-fitment ECU.
